answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line already at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, switching vendors now carries unacceptable delivery risk despite the cost upside seen in memory_c2. Renegotiating with the incumbent (supported by memory_c4's benchmarking success and memory_c1/c6's proven stability and volume-pricing gains) offers a path to meaningful cost reduction toward the 18% target while preserving continuity of supply. Verifying memory_c4's archived record is the highest-value check since it directly underpins the feasibility of extracting real savings without disrupting terms or delivery. Second-sourcing (memory_c3) remains valuable but is a separate decision for next cycle given the one-decision constraint this cycle.
